title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 1C - Djibouti, Egypt, Ethiopia, Gabon

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The official e-visa portal of the Republic of Djibouti is operated by the Immigration Directorate and enables electronic visa applications.
The Egyptian government's official e-visa portal (visa2egypt.gov.eg/eVisa/Home) is the primary online channel for Egypt visa applications.
The Ethiopian government's official e-visa portal (evisa.gov.et) is the primary online channel for Ethiopian visa applications.
The official Gabon e-visa portal (evisa.dgdi.ga) is operated by the Direction Generale de la Documentation et de l'Immigration (DGDI).

batch.name: v10.22.7 Africa evidence tranche 1C - DJ, EG, ET, GA
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Djibouti (DJ), Egypt (EG), Ethiopia (ET), and Gabon (GA). Djibouti's e-visa portal is operated by the Immigration Directorate of the Republic of Djibouti. Egypt's e-visa portal was remediated to the canonical eVisa/Home endpoint during baseline capture because the root path returned only a meta-redirect with no usable text. Ethiopia's e-visa portal is the official government channel. Gabon's e-visa portal is operated by the DGDI but baseline retrieval failed because the upstream TLS certificate is not trusted by the container CA; Gabon is therefore blocked pending a certificate remediation path. Algeria, Comoros, and Congo (Brazzaville) remain excluded or deferred due to TLS or source-confirmation issues. Every proposal requires independent human review.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: E-visa Djibouti - official immigration directorate portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The official e-visa portal of the Republic of Djibouti is operated by the Immigration Directorate and enables electronic visa applications. This supports a proposal that Djibouti directly administers the relevant immigration rules.
